scope_note: Completed contribution-account syntheses for Meta Forest City / Rutherford County. Broad cumulative capital receives an explicit 25-75% construction-eligible allocation before transferred construction benchmarks; operating scenarios translate the 2015 reported-position snapshot with a visible FTE sensitivity; the same-county, same-fiscal-year tax and incentive claims are reconciled before the public-cost break-even threshold; facility water and electricity resource models retain source rounding and scope; supplier and household channels remain separate; and county comparisons are descriptive benchmark gaps rather than causal effects. No net fiscal, audited, or causal result is asserted.
